description.value:
You expend a 1st-rank or higher spell slot to summon a tiny or small contracted ally into an unoccupied square within 30 feet. The ally lasts for 1 minute, has statistics equal to a level-1 minion of your contract type (toad, snake, or slug), and acts on your initiative count, taking 2 actions per turn. You can dismiss it as a free action.

The exact ally is determined by your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-shinobi.class-features.Item.ClFtSummonerPth0]{Summoning Contract}.
